cases.subject: Call.muteAudio() in telnyx/webrtc 2.25.25 not muting outbound RTCRtpSender on supervisor leg
cases.summary: WebRTC SDK muteAudio() fails on supervisor (whisper) leg — mute takes effect briefly then outbound RTP resumes at ~13kbps Opus despite isMuted staying true. Likely ICE renegotiation re-enables the sender track. P1/Critical.
